title: Trinity Verification Contract
description: Per-session acceptance contract authored at nnn and consumed by the Verifier (Phase 3). Authoritative shape per docs/specs/TRINITY_VERIFICATION_CONTRACT_SPEC_V1.md §4.6 + §4.6.1 (precedence-validator clause). additionalProperties:false at every level encodes Article XVI Least Authority + Article XX Passive Core.

id.description: Stable contract identifier; opaque to consumers.

description.description: Human-readable summary of what this contract verifies.

id.description: Acceptance entry identifier; canonical form A1, A2, ...

rule_set.description: Rule-set ID from .ai/policies/verifier-rules.yaml or a tagged-new ID (sandbox_profile_missing, capture_missing_for_artifact, ...). See spec §4.6.

predicates.description: Subset of the rule_set's predicate names that this acceptance entry binds to. May be empty when the rule_set is self-contained.

evidence_keys.description: Evidence keys the executor MUST supply (e.g. test_result.json, git.diff).

command.description: Shell command the verifier executes to gather evidence. Cf. rrr-side acceptance — same shape.

required.description: If true, failure of this entry blocks the rrr terminal gate.

notes.description: Free-form rationale; surfaced in retro and audit payload.

on_fire_verdict.description: Optional mapping of predicate-name to verdict override. Spec §4.6.1: this field MUST NOT contradict rule_set predicate-class membership; precedence_override (a separate field) is forbidden at the schema level.

expected_terminal_verdict.description: Optional: the verdict the planner expects this contract to terminate with on the happy path. Used by §4.6.1 validator to detect rule_set.fallback_verdict divergence.

rationale_for_fallback_divergence.description: Required when expected_terminal_verdict differs from any acceptance entry's rule_set.fallback_verdict (spec §4.6.1).

policy_snapshot.description: SHA-256 snapshots of canonical policy files at nnn time. Spec §5.4 (V1.1 addition). Used to detect mid-session policy drift.
